name: Acute Myeloid Leukemia and Myelodysplastic Syndromes Related to Radiation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues (2016)

criteria.description: Documented history of significant ionizing radiation exposure prior to disease onset
Bone marrow blast count ≥20% for AML or dysplastic changes consistent with MDS
Presence of radiation-associated cytogenetic abnormalities such as monosomy 5 or monosomy 7

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: History of radiation exposure plus bone marrow blast count ≥20% for AML or characteristic dysplastic features for MDS
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of AML/MDS and correlation with clinical history.

pathognomonic.notes: Reduction in red cells, white cells, and platelets

searchTerms: bone marrow not making enough cells
marrow failure causing low blood counts
recurrent infections due to immune weakness
infections caused by low white blood cells

common.symptomName: Easy bruising and petechiae from thrombocytopenia
searchTerms: easy bruising and small red spots
petechiae and bleeding from low platelets
fatigue related to low red blood cells

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement (e.g., cranial nerve palsies)

searchTerms: chemical imbalance from cancer cell death
tumor lysis causing kidney and electrolyte problems

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing blasts and dysplastic cells
Bone marrow biopsy with ≥20% myeloblasts or dysplastic hematopoiesis
imaging: Chest X-ray to evaluate infections or hemorrhage
Abdominal ultrasound or CT for hepatosplenomegaly
genetic: Cytogenetic abnormalities including monosomy 5, monosomy 7, complex karyotype
Mutations in TP53, RUNX1, or ASXL1 genes associated with radiation-related AML/MDS
other: Clinical signs of bone marrow failure

distinguishingFeatures: History of chemotherapy exposure in addition to or instead of radiation

references: Arber DA, et al. The 2016 revision to the World Health Organization classification of myeloid neoplasms and acute leukemia. Blood. 2016.
Orphanet: Acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes related to radiation. ORPHA:164726
Vardiman JW, et al. WHO classification of tumours of haematopoietic and lymphoid tissues. IARC; 2016.
